hero.title: Hojii Jireenyaa Keessan Nu Waliin Argadhaa
hero.description: Hojiiwwan adda addaa argadhaa fi karaa hojii keessan itti fufaa. Gareen hojiiwwan guddaa Itoophiyaa mara wajjin wal qunnamadhaa.

features.title: Maaliif Econnect Filattu?
features.heading: Hojii Dafaan Argadhaa
features.description: Wanti hunda hojii Itoophiyaa keessatti argachuuf barbaachisu. Plataamaanni keenya qophii hojii wajjin wal qunnamsiisuuf kennama.

list.title: Mobilitti Tajaajilaa
list.description: Meeshaa, bakka ykn yeroo kamiiyuu irraa ilaalaa. Plataamaanni keenya garaagarummaan kan tajaajiluudha.

list.title: Haala Hojiirra Ooluu
list.description: Itoophiyaa keessatti kan qindaa'e, plataamaanni keenya dafaa fi amanamuu hundaa'uuf kan kennamedha.

list.title: Nageenya
list.description: Odeeffannoo keessan nageenya keenya jala jira. Protokoolawwan nageenya haaraa kanneen fayyadanna.

list.title: Hojiiwwan Haaraa Beekadhaa
list.description: Hojiiwwan haaraa fi odeeffannoo hojiiwwanii hordofadhaa.

cta.heading: Imala Hojii Keessan Jalqabuu Qabdu?
cta.description: Kumaatamaan qorattoota hojii jireenyaa isaanii Econnect irraa argatan wajjin makamadhaa. Carraan keessan achi jira.

footer.description: Qophii hojii wajjin Itoophiyaa mara wal qunnamsiisna. Imala hojii keessan asii irraa eegala.
